verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible order (logo, can, dominant headline, then the body copy and CTA in a bottom row). Its flaws: the headline runs almost to both canvas edges, the body copy is tiny and sits partly on the yellow circle, and the CTA is crammed into the bottom-right corner. B breaks the reading order: the body copy floats in the green circle above and away from the headline, the logo is shoved to the top right, and the headline sits directly on top of an oversized CTA bar that nearly touches the bottom-left edge. B also leaves the left column cramped while the right side is loose.
